Friends of Milton Public Library Book and Gift Shop
Friends of Milton Public Library Book and Gift Shop, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., 121 Union St., Milton. Used hardcover, paperback, fiction, nonfiction, children’s books, CDs, and DVDs. Milton-themed gifts, T-shirts, sweatshirts, hats, and pottery. Bag of Books sale in Feb, June & Oct. Cash only. For more information go to
